verdict.rationale: Replit only vaguely claims 'Screening and secure services keep apps safe' alongside enterprise controls like SSO/SAML and SOC2, but there is no documented feature for automated security review of a generated app before publishing (e.g., a vulnerability scan or security report step). missing for 10: dedicated pre-deployment security scan/report feature, documentation of what 'screening' actually checks, independent verification that flagged issues are surfaced to developers before go-live.
